ruleDefinitions.name: Use of FSharp Interpreters
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the execution of FSharp Interpreters "FsiAnyCpu.exe" and "FSi.exe"
Both can be used for AWL bypass and to execute F# code via scripts or inline.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\fsi\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\fsianycpu\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "fsi\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "fsianycpu\.exe"))
